description: Source code for the GraphingCalculator view in a calculator application, handling UI interactions, graph updates, sharing, and theming.

classes.name: GraphingCalculator
classes.description: Main class for the graphing calculator view, managing UI, graph interactions, sharing, and theming.

methods.name: RaisePropertyChanged
methods.description: Raises the PropertyChanged event for data binding updates.

methods.name: OnVariableChanged
methods.description: Updates the graph control with new variable values.

methods.name: OnEquationsVectorChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the equations collection, updating the graph accordingly.

methods.name: OnZoomInCommand
methods.description: Performs zoom-in action on the graph.

methods.name: OnZoomOutCommand
methods.description: Performs zoom-out action on the graph.

methods.name: OnShareClick
methods.description: Initiates sharing of the current graph via OS share UI.

methods.name: OnShowTracePopupChanged
methods.description: Shows or hides the trace value popup.

methods.name: OnTracePointChanged
methods.description: Updates trace point display with current coordinates.

methods.name: OnPointerPointChanged
methods.description: Moves the trace pointer to a new position.

methods.name: OnDataRequested
methods.description: Prepares data package for sharing, including graph image, equations, and variables.

methods.name: GraphingControl_LostFocus
methods.description: Handles loss of focus on the graph control, disables tracing if active.

methods.name: GraphingControl_LosingFocus
methods.description: Handles focus loss, cancels focus request if needed.

methods.name: GraphingControl_VariablesUpdated
methods.description: Updates view model with current variables.

methods.name: GraphingControl_GraphViewChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles changes in graph view, updates automation and state.

methods.name: GraphingControl_GraphPlottedEvent
methods.description: Updates automation name after graph plotting.

methods.name: OnEquationKeyGraphFeaturesRequested
methods.description: Displays key features of an equation.

methods.name: OnKeyGraphFeaturesClosed
methods.description: Closes key graph features view.

methods.name: TraceValuePopup_SizeChanged
methods.description: Positions the trace value popup.

methods.name: PositionGraphPopup
methods.description: Calculates and sets the position of the trace popup.

methods.name: ActiveTracing_Checked
methods.description: Enables active tracing mode.

methods.name: ActiveTracing_Unchecked
methods.description: Disables active tracing mode.

methods.name: ActiveTracing_KeyUp
methods.description: Handles key events during active tracing, e.g., Escape key to cancel.

methods.name: ActiveTracing_PointerCaptureLost
methods.description: Handles loss of pointer capture during tracing.

methods.name: GraphSettingsButton_Click
methods.description: Displays graph settings flyout.

methods.name: SwitchModeToggleButton_Toggled
methods.description: Handles toggle between graph and equation modes.

methods.name: DisplayGraphSettings
methods.description: Shows the graph settings flyout.

methods.name: AddTracePointerShadow
methods.description: Adds a shadow effect to the trace pointer.

methods.name: UpdateGraphAutomationName
methods.description: Updates the automation name for accessibility.

methods.name: OnColorValuesChanged
methods.description: Updates theme based on color changes.

methods.name: UpdateGraphTheme
methods.description: Applies theme based on high contrast and app theme settings.

methods.name: OnGraphThemeSettingChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in theme matching setting.

methods.name: Canvas_SizeChanged
methods.description: Initializes pointer position on size change.

methods.name: OnHighContrastChanged
methods.description: Adjusts UI for high contrast mode.

methods.name: OnEquationFormatRequested
methods.description: Formats math equations for display.

methods.name: GraphMenuFlyoutItem_Click
methods.description: Copies graph image to clipboard.

methods.name: OnVisualStateChanged
methods.description: Logs visual state changes.

methods.name: GraphViewButton_Click
methods.description: Toggles graph view mode between manual adjustment and best fit.

methods.name: ShowShareError
methods.description: Displays error dialog if sharing fails.

methods.name: OnGraphingCalculatorLoaded
methods.description: Initializes theme after control is loaded.
